title: Brazil Wraps Up Wheelchair Rugby World Cup in 11th Place
seoTitle: Brazil finishes Wheelchair Rugby World Cup
subtitle: Brazil defeats New Zealand 53-37 to secure 11th place
excerpt: At the Wheelchair Rugby World Cup held at the Paralympic Training Centre in São Paulo, Brazil beat New Zealand 53‑37 to finish 11th in the final standings.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The Wheelchair Rugby World Cup continues to unfold at the Paralympic Training Centre in São Paulo. The host nation’s campaign has now concluded.

In the final round, played on Saturday (22), Brazil defeated New Zealand 53‑37, securing 11th place in the tournament’s final ranking.

With this result, the Brazilian team ends its World Cup journey in 11th position among the participating squads.

With information from Agência Brasil.
